name: Question 12
problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{2}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{2}x)
$$

The Fourier series of the $4$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of the function 

$$
F(x)={\begin{aligned}2, & x\in [0,2) \\ -1, & x\in [-2,0)\end{aligned}
$$

is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{3}.$

${a}_{3}=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the cosine coefficients are given by

$$
{a}_{n}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{L}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=2.$ Also, $f(x)=2$ for $x\in (0,2)$ and $f(x)=-1$ for $x\in (-2,0).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{3} & =\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{-2}^{2}f(x)\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{-2}^{0}(-1)\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x+\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{0}^{2}2\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{2}{3\pi }{[\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{-2}^{0}+\frac{2}{3\pi }{[\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3\pi }{2}x)]}_{0}^{2} \\  & =-\frac{1}{3\pi }(\operatorname{sin}⁡(0)-\operatorname{sin}⁡(-3\pi ))+\frac{2}{3\pi }(\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\pi )-\operatorname{sin}⁡(0)) \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
